integrity: The proof is analytic. A finite numerical replay checks representative degrees but is explicitly supplementary. Source statements were compared at the level of equations and implications; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Local bifurcation theorem only: it proves the unique nearby unequal pair for tau just above the second shared-root value and gives its amplitude, but does not classify remote unequal solutions or the full k>=4 phase diagram. The existence and uniqueness of the source value tau_2(k) is used as a published input.
title: Supercritical symmetry breaking at \(\tau_2(k)\) for 4-periodic SOS boundary laws
